_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/counters/test_counters_put_this_way.py. t_cptw_advisor is Guinan, Ancient Advisor's ability on a plain creature; t_cptw_ward forbids +1/+1 counters on Walls you control, and t_cptw_wall is the Wall it reaches, so one arrival can be shielded while another is not.

cards.name: Test Counting Advisor
cards.oracle_text: {1}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that entered this turn. If you put two or more +1/+1 counters on creatures this way, draw a card.

abilities.text: {1}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that entered this turn. If you put two or more +1/+1 counters on creatures this way, draw a card.

cards.name: Test Wall Ward
cards.oracle_text: Walls you control can't have +1/+1 counters put on them.

abilities.text: Walls you control can't have +1/+1 counters put on them.
